description: The compression stage of the tape model on its own: a soft characteristic curve that pulls the loud parts of a signal down before they reach the tape

params.text: Sets the level at which the curve starts to act, 0dB to 9dB; at 0dB nothing is compressed, and at 9dB anything above -9dB is
Sets how quickly the gain comes down once the signal enters the compressed region, 0.1ms to 50ms
Sets how quickly the gain returns once the signal leaves the compressed region, 10ms to 1000ms

notes: the amount knob comes up fully anticlockwise, at 0dB, so a new module passes the audio through untouched until it is turned up.
the module has no menu of its own beyond Rack's.

inputs.0:
bipolar · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V.
